verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public REST API that exchanges JSON over HTTPS. It ships a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.attio.com/openapi/api, plus guides for filtering and sorting, rate limiting (429 with Retry-After), OAuth flows and webhooks, and per-endpoint reference pages with an in-browser playground. The probe 404s on docs-domain OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served from api.attio.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio exposes a public OpenAPI specification for the Attio REST API.
This allows developers to build apps that read and write information to and from Attio workspaces.
Rate limit responses always have the HTTP status code `429`. They also always include a `Retry-After` header
